summary: Steakholder Foods Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K announcing that its Special General Meeting of Shareholders was adjourned from September 15, 2026 to September 16, 2026 at the same time and place because a quorum was not present. The underlying proxy statement was furnished August 11, 2026, and the ADS voting instruction deadline set by depositary Bank of New York Mellon has passed, so ADS holders can no longer vote. This is a routine meeting adjournment notice, not a special situation; watch for quorum and vote outcomes.
